howto.name: Enter a color in any format
howto.text: HEX (#FF5733), RGB (255, 87, 51), HSL (10, 100%, 60%), or named (coral, tomato, etc.).

howto.name: PrivaTools shows the same color in every format
howto.text: Live conversion: HEX, RGB, RGBA, HSL, HSLA, HSV, CMYK, and named-color match (if any).

howto.name: Copy the value you need
howto.text: Click any value to copy. Runs entirely in your browser — no network roundtrip.

faq.a: Yes — paste #RRGGBBAA or rgba(...) and the alpha channel is preserved across all output formats.

faq.q: Why does my CMYK look different from print?
faq.a: CMYK conversion uses a sRGB → CMYK approximation. For exact print color, use your printer's color profile.
